name: Spicy Curried Pork Burger & Tossed Salad with Honey-Lime Dressing

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Place pork, bread crumbs, Worcestershire sauce, and spices in a large bowl, then mix with your hands until well combined. Form the pork mixture into 6 equal-sized patties and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg lean ground pork
½ cup panko bread crumbs
1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
1 tbsp curry powder
1 ½ tsp coriander, ground
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add burger patties and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes; flip patties and cook an additional 5-7 minutes, until cooked through. Once done, transfer to a clean plate.
While the burgers are cooking, place ketchup and crushed red pepper in a small bowl. Stir to combine the spicy ketchup and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup ketchup
½ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ limes
3 medium carrots
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Juice limes into a clean large bowl. Add oil, honey, and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp honey
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel and trim carrots; using a julienne (or regular) peeler, peel the carrot into noodle-like strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and halve cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl.
Peel, halve, and slice shallots lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl.
Chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Spread spicy ketchup over the bottom half of each bun; top with burger patties and a small handful of salad. Close with the top half of each bun. Serve with remaining salad on the side and enjoy!
